subject: Print node name on a best effort basis if light weight message is received before link stabilization (#2825)
reason: The change only rewrites serverLog message text in cluster_legacy.c, factoring the existing `link->node ? name : "<unknown>"` null checks into two inline helpers and adding the human node name to a few debug/notice/warning log lines. No command reply, cluster-bus protocol behaviour, link lifecycle, or data path changes: links are freed and packets processed exactly as before, so there is no observable behaviour for a scenario's oracles or a compared sequence to distinguish.
